{{Short description|Estonian athletics competitor (1938–2019)}}
'''Vilve Maremäe''' (since 1971 '''Vilve  Nummert'''; 30 January 1938 – 27 July 2019) was an [[Estonia]]n athletics competitor.<ref name="ESBL">{{cite web |title=Vilve_Maremäe |url=https://www.esbl.ee/biograafia/Vilve_Marem%C3%A4e |website=www.esbl.ee |access-date=28 March 2022}}</ref>

She was born in [[Uue-Põltsamaa Rural Municipality]], [[Viljandi County]]. In 1961 she graduated from the [[University of Tartu]] with a degree in chemistry.<ref name="ESBL" />

She began athletics training at Tartu Pioneers' House, coached by Ernst Pertel. Later her coaches were Vilma Jürisma, Helver Unger and [[Fred Kudu]]. She won gold medal in the [[1957 World Festival of Youth and Students]] in pentathlon. She was 26-time Estonian champion in different athletics disciplines. She was a member of the Estonian national athletics team.<ref name="ESBL" />

Personal best:<ref name="ESBL" />
* 100 m: 12.1 s (1957)
* 200 m: 25.5 s (1957)
* 80 m hurdles: 11.2 s (1964)
* long jump: 6.14 m (1960)
